description: Inspect a real process and suspend it.
hint: Identify the PID in ps or top and request SIGSTOP.

description: Lower the scheduling priority of a practice worker.
hint: Inspect the NI column with ps and use renice for the PID.

description: Repair default password aging.
hint: Review PASS_MAX_DAYS, PASS_MIN_DAYS and PASS_WARN_AGE in login.defs.

description: Initialize a disposable account password and require rotation.
hint: Use openssl passwd -6 and review the password and last change fields in shadow(5).

description: Validate a narrowly scoped sudo delegation.
hint: Use a group specification, root run-as and the full command including arguments.

description: Repair static hostname and hosts resolution.
hint: Use a single static hostname and put the canonical name first in its hosts entry.

description: Correct the timezone file in an offline root.
hint: Look under /usr/share/zoneinfo. A symlink or a copy of the requested zone file is valid.

description: Route authentication warnings and more severe syslog events.
hint: Review the facility.priority selector in rsyslog.conf.

description: Diagnose an AVC and repair a persistent web-content context.
hint: Use the normal HTTP content type and a regular expression that also matches descendants.

description: Diagnose an HTTP bind denial and repair its port assignment.
hint: Use semanage port export format with the HTTP port type and tcp protocol.

description: Repair the policy boolean for NFS home directories.
hint: Use persistent semanage boolean export syntax.

description: Limit a firewalld zone to the specified source and port.
hint: Review source and port elements in firewalld.zone.

description: Repair an LVM and XFS layout in a Kickstart storage plan.
hint: Review part, volgroup and logvol in the RHEL Kickstart reference.

description: Repair a boot-blocking filesystem identifier.
hint: Compare the failed device in the boot log with the UUID in the blkid inventory.

description: Write a loop that produces a separate report for each input item.
hint: Read input line by line, skip blanks and redirect printf output to each report.

description: Install an original signed RPM into a local prefix.
hint: Use rpm -i with --dbpath and --prefix. Use --define to set _tmppath.

description: Upgrade a signed RPM in a local package database.
hint: Use rpm -U with the same local database and prefix as the first install.

description: Remove an RPM from a local package database.
hint: Use rpm -e and the exercise --dbpath. Query the same database to check.

description: Restore a package repository with signature verification.
hint: Set baseurl and gpgkey to file URLs and enable gpgcheck and repo_gpgcheck.

description: Mount and verify a temporary filesystem in an isolated mount namespace.
hint: Use mount -t tmpfs with size, nosuid and nodev options.

description: Mirror a directory tree preserving modes and symlinks.
hint: Review rsync archive mode, source trailing slash and deletion options.

description: Transfer a file using the OpenSSH SFTP subsystem.
hint: Start sftp in direct mode with -D and use get in the interactive session.

description: Resume a suspended process.
hint: Identify the original PID and send SIGCONT.

description: Recover the credential database of a disposable offline image.
hint: Use the staged shadow database and compare the password hash and aging fields.

description: Provide effective ACL access and default inheritance.
hint: Use setfacl access and default entries. Inspect effective permissions with getfacl.

description: Create a Linux LVM partition in a practice image.
hint: Use GPT and select the Linux LVM partition type.

description: Make a logical volume persistently available at a mount point.
hint: Use the logical-volume mapper path or the volume group and logical volume path in fstab.

description: Recover an enforcing SELinux boot configuration.
hint: Review SELINUX and SELINUXTYPE in the offline configuration.

description: Restrict an NFS export to a single authorized client.
hint: Review exports(5) and put the options directly after the client address.

description: Repair a TuneD profile based on balanced.
hint: Use include=balanced and a sysctl section in tuned.conf.

description: Disable a service in a disposable system root.
hint: Use systemctl --root=PATH disable UNIT and check is-enabled.

description: Start a transient systemd user service.
hint: Use systemd-run --user with --unit and --working-directory.

description: Stop a running systemd user service.
hint: Use systemctl --user stop on the named practice unit.

description: Schedule and verify a real systemd user job.
hint: Use systemd-run --user --on-active and specify a transient unit name.
